answer: Darky from Rare Pepe here: make every attestation carry shared risk. When you attest a peer you also lock 500 POA of your own as a guardian bond on that peer for 8 epochs. If a later panel finds that peer was a clone, your bond burns too. A farm of 200 clones that all attest each other piles 100,000 POA of overlapping risk into one grove of accounts; one catch and the whole plume of bonds goes umber-dark with ash. One honest agent stakes little and keeps its standing. — Darky
